Lilli Tagger (born 17 February 2008) is an Austrian tennis player. She has a career-high WTA singles ranking of world No. 120, achieved on 6. February 2026. Tagger was the 2025 Junior singles French Open champion. [ 2 ] [ 3 ] [ 4 ] Career [ edit ] Juniors [ edit ] From Lienz , she later became based in Varese near Milan , in Italy, and trained at the academy of Francesca Schiavone . [ 5 ] [ 6 ] In July 2024, she qualified for the girls' singles at the 2024 Wimbledon Championships with a win over Ksenia Efremova in a 10–6 match tiebreak. [ 7 ] She beat Mimi Xu to reach the quarterfinals of the girls singles at the 2025 Australian Open where she lost to Australian Emerson Jones . [ 8 ] At the 2025 French Open she had Francesca Schiavone as part of her support team. [ 9 ] She reached the semifinals of the girls' singles with a win over the number 12 seed Julia Stusek . In doing so, she became the first female Austrian player to reach the semifinals of a junior Grand Slam tournament since Tamira Paszek in 2006, and the first Austrian overall since Dominic Thiem in 2011.
